solution:
**Given:**

Class Intervals (CI) and Frequencies (F):

 
 

 CI
 0-10
 10-20

 50-60

 CF

 22

 44
 50
 
 

 

**Formula Used:**

The median class is the class where the cumulative frequency (CF) is greater than or equal to half of the total frequency (N/2).

Median formula: {Median} = L + ( (frac{N)/(2) - CF꜀}{f} ) times h 

Where:

 
• **L** = Lower boundary of the median class
 
• **N** = Total frequency
 
• **CF꜀** = Cumulative frequency of the class before the median class
 
• **f** = Frequency of the median class
 
• **h** = Class interval width

 

**Calculation:**

N/2 = 50/2 = 25, CF greater than 25 is 32, so the median class: 40 - 50

L = 40, CF = 22, f = 10, h = 10

Using the median formula:

 {Median} = 40 + ( (25 - 22)/(10) ) times 10 

⇒ {Median} = 40 + ( (3)/(10) ) times 10 

⇒ {Median} = 40 + 3 

⇒ {Median} = 43 

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
